note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.55, private edition (local, never published or distributed), all XA: no CD-DA track. The v0.54 Private lineup with the lost-GP0(1Fh) fix (the draw-done request the GPU must see closed, for FPGA PSX cores such as the SuperStation One) in the rows that carry it: Hollow Knight, Quake, WipEout, NitroXide, Half-Life, Cortex Ignition 0.4b and Cortex Citadel. The launcher is unchanged (editor 3cb1839a, SDK 649c7ed). Left out: Arcade, PSXcel, Counter-Strike and the hardware tests.
